title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAMS_BLOCKED Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P14 requirement-home tests, permanent frame-codec benchmark dry run, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers STREAMS_BLOCKED type mapping, Type and Maximum Streams field-shape proof, advertised stream-count preservation, 2^60 limit enforcement, valid protected receive acceptance, and malformed protected receive close behavior.
expected_result: The requirement-home tests show type 0x16 and 0x17 parsing and protected receive acceptance, rejection of non-STREAMS_BLOCKED and non-minimal type encodings, Maximum Streams variable-length integer boundary handling, exact frame consumption, preservation of advertised stream counts through parse and format, rejection of values above 2^60, and protected FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR close behavior for larger encoded values.
procedure: Run the focused S19P14 requirement-home filter for requirements 0002 and 0004 through 0009.
Run the permanent QuicFrameCodecBenchmarks STREAMS_BLOCKED dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing shared stream-limit codec remains the parser and formatter seam for MAX_STREAMS and STREAMS_BLOCKED frames.
The protected Application Data runtime has 1-RTT open packet-protection material.
The existing outbound STREAMS_BLOCKED runtime-emission lane remains scoped separately under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0007.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim outbound STREAMS_BLOCKED emission scheduling, pending-open retry behavior, public flow-control APIs, or complete interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S19P14 requirement-home filter passed 38/38, the STREAMS_BLOCKED frame-codec Dry benchmark ran both parse and format benchmarks, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks S19P14 0002 and 0004 through 0009 trace_clean, SpecTrace core validation passed for 406 artifacts, and git diff --check passed with only CRLF normalization warnings.
